description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum `GatewayPayloadDecoding` with static methods to decode payloads of type `AnyCodable` into specified `Decodable` types, including optional decoding. It serves as a helper for decoding payloads in the application.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an `AnyCodable` payload into the specified `Decodable` type `T`.

methods.name: decodeIfPresent
methods.description: Attempts to decode an optional `AnyCodable` payload into the specified `Decodable` type `T`. Returns nil if payload is nil.
